limitations: The user approved frontal small steps only, not side-view running or finished motion aesthetics.
The host uses run states as drag feedback; pointer screen displacement is independent of the fixed sprite schedule. No screen-world no-slip claim.
Drag release or direction/state change can interrupt any cel and restore the underlying task state; three loops then idle is only the uninterrupted-row schedule.
Leg joints and smooth frontal projection are a 2-D puppet hypothesis, not recovered anatomy or a full 3-D rig.
Foreground outlines are estimated from flattened source pixels; adjacent hair fringe and residual boundary ghosts remain possible.
The old flat source-over neutral failure is preserved. Current conditioned occlusion reconstructs neutral RGBA exactly, without proving clean artist layers or nonzero edge ownership.
At 80 px the approximately 1.2-native-pixel foot lift and gaze cue are weak; naturalness and left/right legibility are pending.
The root shifts toward the supporting foot, not the travel direction. Its motion is a restrained 2-D design, not a measured mass centre or proven physical balance.
Clothes/head/hair follow the root rigidly; delayed soft follow-through and full entry/exit remain missing.

Direct material sampling uses a coverage-normalized backing convention. Only composite roundoff below 1e-10 premultiplied units is canonicalized at every pose, not a neutral-raster shortcut; full neutral native RGBA matches the original sampler.

Each swing shows rising, peak and approach poses; left contact occurs at slot 4, right contact at the next cycle's slot 0. First/last pixels are intentionally not equal. Reference curves select poses only, not native interpolation or measured endpoint velocity.

The 220 ms final hold makes the right approach asymmetric and more elevated than the left. Cyclic/root and fallback jumps remain discrete; continuous takeoff/landing, impact/follow-through and arbitrary exit remain unproven.
